title: CDF Terabyte-Scale Performance Envelope
evidence_status: P3 IMPLEMENTATION CLOSEOUT — green results, partial cells, accepted residuals, and unproven ambitions are shown without relabeling.

targets.label: Parquet file/glob → package
targets.target: ≥0.7× raw Arrow; ≥1.5 GB/s aggregate; row-group parallel
targets.absolute_result: 425.1 MB logical decoded in 113.9 ms (3.73 GB/s logical); no like-for-like 1.5 GB/s physical package cell
targets.relative_result: 0.90× raw Arrow decode; governed FineWeb path 0.779× favorable same-data reference
targets.memory_result: bounded row-group frontier; 8.59 GB scale curve stayed below 1.6 GB RSS
targets.host: Apple M5 Pro local release controls
targets.reference: arrow-rs Parquet decode and favorable same-data Parquet rewrite
targets.bias: The logical decode rate omits package persistence; the governed path includes destination work. No cross-host synthesis is used.
targets.residual: The ratio target and row-group architecture are demonstrated; a comparable physical-byte package cell at 1.5 GB/s is not.

targets.label: CSV → package
targets.relative_result: 0.680× raw Arrow CSV with the same bounded inference pass
targets.memory_result: one-pass sequential decode; no retained parallel pre-scan
targets.bias: Hard-linked warm files minimize device pressure; CDF additionally validates, segments, compresses, hashes, and finalizes.
targets.residual: The roofline ratio is green; the 400 MB/s absolute ambition is not.

targets.label: 1 TiB synthetic glob → Parquet
targets.target: default budget; stable RSS; linear scaling to device saturation
targets.absolute_result: 1.0086 TiB and 5.436 billion rows in 499.07 s; 2.222 GB/s logical; 10.892 million rows/s
targets.relative_result: 5.40× the identical prior governed run; 6.78 equivalent cores and 84.8% of the physical-core roofline
targets.memory_result: 3.923 GB process peak under default 4 GiB; 3.163/3.651 GB managed peak; zero spill/OOM
targets.mode: generated default-policy scale run / 5 GiB cgroup
targets.reference: identical 2026-07-25 governed baseline; no synthetic unique-byte device roofline
targets.bias: The generator uses repeated content and hard links, and Zstd compressed the destination to 46.4 MB; this proves logical work, CPU scheduling, lifecycle, and memory, not unique-source-byte or cold-device throughput.
targets.residual: Default-budget completion and near physical-core saturation are green; unique-source-byte cold-device saturation and the SMT scaling knee were not demonstrated by this repeated-content hard-link fixture.

targets.label: Correctness/evidence overhead
targets.absolute_result: hashing 0.06%; CLI rendering -0.44% within variance; validation and destination work reported separately
targets.relative_result: no single semantically equivalent whole-product raw comparator exists
targets.memory_result: correctness structures share the governed memory ledger
targets.reference: exact hash-free durability control and progress-disabled product control
targets.bias: Adding unlike component percentages would create a false whole-product scalar. The global 10% claim is therefore withheld.
targets.residual: A whole-product semantically equivalent raw comparator remains unavailable; CDF makes no ≤10% aggregate claim.

architecture.label: Constant process memory
architecture.target: RSS is a function of policy, not input size; clean failure below minimum
architecture.absolute_result: 5/20/100 GiB under 2 GiB with 1.54–1.58 GiB RSS; 1 TiB at 3.923 GB RSS under default 4 GiB
architecture.relative_result: flat memory curve across 20× input growth
architecture.memory_result: 64 MiB policy fails typed Data before artifacts; forced spill laws clean up
architecture.reference: input-size geometric curve and explicit impossible-budget control
architecture.bias: Repeated-content fixtures prove memory/lifecycle slope, not unique-byte device capacity.

architecture.label: Jobs invariance
architecture.target: fixed inputs produce identical package/receipt/state semantics at jobs 1/N
architecture.absolute_result: format, destination, REST, SQL, failure, drain, and isolated-worker matrices pass
architecture.memory_result: task/permit/frontier peaks remain within admitted authorities
architecture.host: deterministic fixtures plus Apple M5 Pro scale curve
architecture.bias: Scale timing is host-specific; identity equivalence is the portable law.

architecture.label: Core native format engines
architecture.target: streaming, fail-closed, registry-owned Parquet/CSV/JSON/NDJSON and transforms
architecture.absolute_result: all core engines and gzip/zstd/bzip2/xz/lz4/snappy/brotli transforms are terminal
architecture.relative_result: adding a codec does not extend generic source/runtime match trees
architecture.memory_result: byte sources, transforms, codecs, and batches share accounted ownership
architecture.host: cross-platform conformance plus named release controls

architecture.label: Implemented foreign boundaries
